message.content:
This is a flat steel washer, so it falls under heading 7318 (screws, bolts, nuts, washers and similar articles of iron or steel). Within that heading, subheading 7318.22 covers other non-threaded articles, which includes washers other than spring washers. SUS301 is stainless steel, which points to 7318.22.00 and a statistical suffix.

The 7318.22.00 subheading is for "Other washers." The 10-digit codes are as follows:
- 7318.22.0000 is the single national line, covering other washers.

The spring washers fall under 7318.21.

The description says a flat washer, so 7318.22.0000 applies. It is used in a headset, but the washer is a general-purpose item and is not a specialized part. Under Section XVI Note 2(a), parts that are goods of heading 7318 are excluded from Section XVI parts classification. The washer therefore stays in 7318.
